description: Full detail for one API by aid (provider:api-slug); set include=["content"] to inline artifact bodies. Results carry `next`: the sub-resources that exist for this entity and the exact tool call that retrieves each, computed from this record. Pass include_next=false to omit it.

aid.description: API id in the form provider:api-slug, as find_apis returns it, e.g. "stripe:stripe-api".

artifact_types.description: Only return artifacts of these types, e.g. ["OpenAPI"].

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include.description: Pass ["content"] to inline each artifact's body instead of just its URL.

include_next.description: Set false to omit the `next` affordance block.

name: get_api
